question: What attainment results from performing this practice every day?
premises: The prescribed practice is performed daily.
A result is promised to the practitioner.
The attainment takes the form of desire.
inference: By practicing thus every day, he may attain success in the form of desire.
uncertainties: kāma-rūpataḥ may mean according to desire or in the form of Kāma
plain_english: Thus, by practicing every day, he may attain success in the form of desire.
